svg.aria-label: The citation-check mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Citation compliance (agent); You decide (stop); Citation audit report (agent) | paper: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Citation compliance (agent); Citation compliance once more, when a check fails (agent, only when needed); A claim the run cannot support, or a reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the entries fail the same check (stop); Citation report (agent).
